description: Cooperative multiplayer for Transport Fever 3. The mod adds no content. It needs the FeverLink3 native module (winhttp.dll, copied next to TransportFever3.exe from the release zip); without it the mod does nothing. With it, a FeverLink3 button appears in the bottom bar: host or join a game there. The mod stamps player actions, applies every player's actions at the same simulation step and reports world checksums.
name: FeverLink3 Multiplayer
summary: Co-op multiplayer (needs the FeverLink3 native module)
